verification.scope: One connected Rev-A prototype; other devices were not individually verified.
verification.write_scope: Application partition only; NVS, partition table and bootloader preserved.
verification.nfc_transfer_test: No live payment performed; console notification paths reviewed and firmware build passed.
verification.runtime_check: USB console responded to heap and nfc status commands; NFC reached idle after startup.
verification.startup_observation: Keyset refresh for mint slot 1 failed before NFC initialization completed.

configuration.wifi_credentials: Local ignored main/wifi_config.h; credentials and firmware binaries are not published.
configuration.display: Boost disabled and reset asserted for bring-up.

notes: Subsequent README, evidence and ignore-rule commits do not change application source.
Rebuilding at another path or commit changes build metadata and can change the binary hash.
USB reconnection with a battery attached may require RESET due to the Rev-A VBUS backfeed issue.
